u.english: You got access to them, there's no handcuffs, and they're naked.

target.text: Temos acesso à pessoa, sem algemas e está nua.

translation.text: You got access to them, there's no handcuffs, and they're naked.

u.english: Nobody has the attention span anymore to just sit and play a game.

target.text: Já ninguém tem capacidade de concentração para se sentar e jogar.
